t: The Gemini XF is a slimline, low-profile wall light with an understated geometric form and matt black finish. Provides focused downward illumination that defines paths, low-level boundaries and architectural surfaces. Low-maintenance lighting solution fitted with high-power integrated LEDs. Produces 3000K warm white light ensuring consistent energy efficient performance with no need for bulb replacements. Built for long-term outdoor use and is a practical, design-led lighting solution for modern exterior schemes. Crafted from die-cast aluminium and IP54 rated.
